successful_progress.normalization: First response accepted; HCN identity is normalized, with five requested Goals. Identity resolution itself did not run.

method.reason: For the fixed-geometry GIAO shielding of the 3-atom HCN system, PBE0 is a hybrid DFT choice permitted by the request; it generally provides a balanced description for shielding tensors while remaining affordable for one small molecule. Cost is modest: 3 atoms, no optimization, one gas-phase NMR calculation; def2-TZVP keeps the basis compact enough for the 4-core/192 MB-per-process execution envelope. RHF would be cheaper but is a lower-level treatment for correlation-sensitive shielding; PBE0 is selected with cost and accuracy in mind. Actual ORCA input keywords and numerical settings will be recorded.

basis.reason: def2-TZVP is explicitly permitted and is a triple-zeta all-electron basis suitable for a small molecule; for HCN it is tractable in a single fixed-geometry GIAO NMR job under the available 4-core/192 MB-per-process resources. def2-SVP would be cheaper but less flexible for the shielding tensor. The choice is paired with PBE0 and will be recorded in the actual ORCA input; no basis-set extrapolation or chemical-shift referencing is implied.
